seedPackets.title: Almost Invention Workshop Step Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, printable, offline paper packet for older writers to turn a yard, garden view, porch view, or table detail into a clear test-and-revise sequence.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print the paper packet, set one pencil on the table, choose a yard, garden view, porch view, window view, table, or park edge, and keep the work to look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look for one visible or audible detail, imagine it as a nearly useful paper invention, and arrange the idea into three clear steps before revising one step.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: My almost-invention is designed for ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Detail seeds: I can use a shape detail ____________________, a sound detail ____________________, and a clear verb ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A workshop tester realizes the paper invention almost works when ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: First ____________________; then the test shows ____________________; because of that, the inventor changes ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Shorten or clarify one step so a reader can follow it: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to one detail, sketch the paper invention, and write the revised step here: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use the clearest step to start a short workshop scene about ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Margin Note Market Revision Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, printable, offline paper packet for turning a yard, garden view, window view, or table detail into kind, specific revision work.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print the paper packet, choose a yard, garden view, porch view, window view, table, or park edge, and remind the writer to look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine only.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look or listen for one broad detail, imagine it as a note from Margin Note Market, and change a vague comment into one useful revision task.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: The margin note I found says ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Detail seeds: A specific word to improve is ____________________, a clearer detail is ____________________, and a kind question is ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: At Margin Note Market, a writer receives a vague note and turns it into this useful next task: ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: The first note says ____________________; the writer asks ____________________; the revised line becomes ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one fuzzy comment with a precise action the writer can try: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Work silently at the table and revise only one sentence: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this margin note to improve one story paragraph: ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Order Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, printable, offline paper packet for older writers to use a yard, window view, porch view, or table detail as the order clue for a finished mini story.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print the paper packet, choose a yard, garden view, porch view, window view, table, or park edge, and keep the activity to look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look for one detail that suggests a beginning, middle, or ending, then imagine it as the clue that fixes a finished paper packet's order.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: My Binding Day packet promises a story about ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Detail seeds: The opening clue is ____________________, the turning detail is ____________________, and the final image is ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: On Binding Day, a finished paper packet feels out of order until the writer notices ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: The first page shows ____________________; the middle page changes when ____________________; the final page lands on ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Rearrange one sentence or add a clearer bridge between two moments: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number three paper page ideas, then write the bridge sentence here: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use the final image to polish the ending of a tiny story: ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Index Card Theater Cue Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, printable, offline paper packet for using a table, porch view, window view, or park edge detail to build a two-line scene with a clear character choice.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print the paper packet, choose a yard, garden view, porch view, window view, table, or park edge, and keep the writing based on look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Point to one broad detail, imagine it as an index card cue, and write two lines where the second line changes what the character chooses next.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: The index card cue for my character is ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Detail seeds: My setting clue is ____________________, my character wants ____________________, and the second line changes ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: At Index Card Theater Club, two cards create a scene when one character chooses ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: First the character expects ____________________; then another line reveals ____________________; after that, the scene points toward ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one action or setting cue that shows the character choice without explaining too much: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch two blank cards and write only the line that changes the scene: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use the strongest cue to write a short table scene about ____________________.
